actions.name: Terminate Blocking Queries & Release Table Locks
actions.mechanism: Issues pg_cancel_backend / pg_terminate_backend on blocked transactions holding ExclusiveLock on inventory tables
actions.description: Eliminates database thread contention and queue stalling by clearing hung queries causing backpressure.
actions.playbook_ref: PB-DB-01: Postgres Lock Contention & Slow Query Recovery

actions.name: Drain & Re-initialize Database Connection Pool
actions.mechanism: Signals connection pool proxy to gracefully evict idle/leaked connections and reset connection pool headroom
actions.description: Restores database connection availability when pool slots are exhausted.

actions.name: Scale Inventory Worker Replicas & Clear RPC Backlog
actions.mechanism: Horizontally autoscales inventory-service pods (+2 replicas) and sheds saturated worker queues
actions.description: Absorbs high service latency and worker queue backlog by expanding horizontal capacity.

actions.name: Engage Circuit Breaker & Fallback to Local Redis Cache
actions.mechanism: Trips downstream DB circuit breaker to serve cached inventory availability, isolating callers from database wait
actions.description: Protects upstream order processing by falling back to cached stock counts.

actions.name: Rolling Restart of Deadlocked Inventory Pods
actions.mechanism: Performs phased rolling restart of degraded inventory pods to clear unhandled deadlock/crash state
actions.description: Restores service reliability after unrecoverable application error cascade.

actions.name: Apply Ingress Rate Shedding & Flush Pending Order Queue
actions.mechanism: Enforces token-bucket admission control to discard queue overflow and relieve mediator thread pool
actions.description: Relieves mediator queueing saturation and restores checkout pipeline throughput.

actions.name: Increase RPC Retry Backoff & Clear Deadlocked Requests
actions.mechanism: Applies jittered exponential backoff and cancels hung outgoing client requests to break retry loops
actions.description: Dissolves retry storm between order-service and downstream dependencies.

actions.name: Failover Payment Route to Standby Acquirer Gateway
actions.mechanism: Switches outgoing payment gateway upstream DNS/VIP route to standby acquirer partner
actions.description: Bypasses third-party gateway connection timeouts and payment validation failures.

actions.name: Graceful Container Restart & Refresh Auth/JWKS Cache
actions.mechanism: Triggers graceful rolling restart of payment pods and evicts expired security token keys
actions.description: Restores payment verification pipeline after internal auth crash or deadlock.
actions.playbook_ref: PB-PAY-02: Payment Worker Pod Graceful Restart

actions.name: Autoscale Payment Service Replicas
actions.mechanism: Adds worker pods to payment deployment to absorb external network latency delay
actions.description: Mitigates queue build-up when external payment provider responses are sluggish.

actions.name: Engage Ingress Rate Limiting & Shed 504 Timeouts
actions.mechanism: Applies token bucket rate limiter at ingress edge, returning 429 to non-critical traffic to protect core routing
actions.description: Protects API Gateway from cascade failure during widespread downstream timeouts.
